brief.aim: The table was assembled to predict whether a client subscribes to a term deposit (y, no/yes), a binary outcome; call duration is known only after the call and leaks the result, so it is a leakage suspect and not a feature.
brief.repeated_subjects: Clients may be contacted more than once; no client identifier is present, so rows are treated as independent contacts.
brief.unit: One telemarketing contact record (a client contacted in a campaign)
